style: Bright, heroic picture-book look for a kindergarten health lesson: bold friendly shapes, clean outlines, warm sunny colors.

assets.name: town
assets.prompt: Empty background: a friendly small town street on a sunny day, seen from the side. A cozy house with a red door on the far left, a sidewalk, a few trees, a small school building far on the right, a big open blue sky. The middle and right of the picture are open sky and lawn with lots of empty space. No people, no animals, no text, no signs with words.

assets.name: pip
assets.prompt: A cheerful cartoon young red fox superhero called Pip, standing proudly with hands on hips, a short blue cape and a small yellow star on the chest, big friendly eyes, full body, front view.

assets.name: pip-tired
assets.prompt: The same cartoon young red fox superhero Pip, blue cape and yellow star, now yawning and sleepy with droopy eyes, rubbing one eye, full body, front view.

assets.name: pip-cheer
assets.prompt: The same cartoon young red fox superhero Pip, blue cape and yellow star, now jumping for joy with both arms up and a big smile, full body, front view.

assets.name: mouth
assets.prompt: A big friendly cartoon mouth wide open in a smile, front view: pink lips, a row of eight clean white upper teeth and a row of eight clean white lower teeth, pink gums and a small pink tongue. Just the mouth and lips, no face, no nose, no eyes.

assets.name: wash-wet
assets.prompt: A pair of a young child's cartoon hands, seen from the front, just the two hands and wrists, no arms, no body, no face. Friendly bold outlines, warm skin, five fingers on each hand. The hands are held under a gentle stream of clean running water, with water drops splashing off the fingers.

assets.name: wash-soap
assets.prompt: A pair of a young child's cartoon hands, seen from the front, just the two hands and wrists, no arms, no body, no face. Friendly bold outlines, warm skin, five fingers on each hand. One hand holds out a palm with a small blob of pink soap on it, the other hand points at it, a few small bubbles.

assets.name: wash-scrub
assets.prompt: A pair of a young child's cartoon hands, seen from the front, just the two hands and wrists, no arms, no body, no face. Friendly bold outlines, warm skin, five fingers on each hand. The hands are rubbing together covered in fluffy white soap suds, fingers interlaced, lots of round bubbles floating up.

assets.name: wash-rinse
assets.prompt: A pair of a young child's cartoon hands, seen from the front, just the two hands and wrists, no arms, no body, no face. Friendly bold outlines, warm skin, five fingers on each hand. The soapy hands are rinsed under running water, suds sliding off into drops.

assets.name: wash-dry
assets.prompt: A pair of a young child's cartoon hands, seen from the front, just the two hands and wrists, no arms, no body, no face. Friendly bold outlines, warm skin, five fingers on each hand. The hands are drying on a soft blue towel, clean and shiny.
